components.name: Main Logic Board (Motherboard)
components.reasoning: This is the central printed circuit board housing the CPU, chipset, memory slots, and key integrated circuits, always procured as a distinct manufactured assembly.

components.name: Central Processing Unit (CPU) Module or Package
components.reasoning: Though often soldered onto the motherboard, CPUs are considered separate components with distinct supply chains and manufacturing processes, critical for computing performance.

components.name: System Memory (RAM) Module
components.reasoning: Usually DDR4 or DDR5 SO-DIMM or soldered memory modules, they are major procurable subassemblies distinct from the motherboard.

components.name: Solid State Drive (SSD) Storage Module
components.reasoning: SSDs are separate storage devices with standardized interfaces (e.g., M.2, PCIe NVMe) procured independently across most laptop designs.

components.name: Display Assembly (LCD or OLED Panel with backlight/touch)
components.reasoning: The integrated screen module, including panel, backlight, digitizer (if touchscreen), and often a protective cover, is a large procured module with a distinct supply chain.

components.name: Keyboard Module
components.reasoning: The keyboard is a key input subassembly typically sourced as a distinct unit including keycaps, switches, and underlying membrane or mechanical components.

components.name: Battery Pack (Lithium-ion or Lithium-polymer)
components.reasoning: The rechargeable battery pack is a critical and separately procured component with its own supply chain and certifications.

components.name: Touchpad Module
components.reasoning: Commonly a distinct input subassembly, especially in mid-to-high-end laptops, procured separately from the mainboard and keyboard.

components.name: Cooling Assembly (Fan and Heat Sink)
components.reasoning: Active cooling solutions are critical thermal management assemblies procured as integrated units to maintain CPU/GPU temperature.

components.name: Chassis or Enclosure (Base and Lid)
components.reasoning: The structural housing, often made of aluminum or magnesium alloy, is a major manufactured assembly including the bottom case and display lid.

components.name: Power Adapter (External AC Charger)
components.reasoning: Though technically an accessory, it is generally procured as a distinct manufactured product essential for powering and charging laptops.

components.name: Laptop Chassis (Top and Bottom Enclosures)
components.reasoning: The structural outer shell including top cover and base that houses and protects internal components, procured as molded plastic or metal assemblies, universally present in all laptops as a distinct manufacturing item.

components.name: LCD Display Module
components.reasoning: The complete display unit including LCD panel, backlight, and sometimes touchscreen sensor, procured as a single assembly separate from the mainboard, essential for user interface in all laptops.

components.name: Keyboard Assembly
components.reasoning: The full keyboard unit including keycaps, internal circuit membranes, and sometimes a backlight, is a discrete module procured separately and installed onto the chassis.

components.name: Touchpad Assembly
components.reasoning: The touch-sensitive input device typically supplied as a complete module with integrated PCB and connector, standard in most commercial laptops, procured separately from the keyboard and mainboard.

components.name: Mainboard (Motherboard)
components.reasoning: The primary PCB hosting CPU, memory slots, I/O controllers, and power circuits, procured as a complete assembly from contract manufacturers or OEM suppliers, absolutely essential and distinct.

components.name: Battery Pack
components.reasoning: Rechargeable lithium-ion or lithium-polymer battery pack providing portable power, a modular unit sourced separately for easy replacement and regulatory compliance.

components.name: Bottom Cover/Access Door
components.reasoning: Subassembly forming the base enclosure, often separately removable for service access; sometimes integrated into the chassis but often procured or manufactured distinctly.

components.name: Hinges and Hinge Assemblies
components.reasoning: Mechanical pivot parts connecting display lid to base, critical for the clamshell form factor, typically separate metal or composite assemblies sourced independently.

components.name: Cooling Fan Assembly
components.reasoning: Active cooling unit including fan and heatsink, procured as a distinct assembly to manage internal thermal performance, common in virtually all laptops but occasionally passively cooled in ultra-thin models.

components.name: Display Bezel
components.reasoning: Plastic or metal frame surrounding the LCD panel providing protection and aesthetics, often a separate part but occasionally integrated into the display module itself.
